decisions.rule: Store attributed exchange wallet balances as wallet holdings, not exchange reserves, customer balances or tradable float.
double_count_controls: Exclude cbXRP reserve from customer-float estimates when already represented in Coinbase wallet totals.
Exclude Binance-Peg reserve from customer-float estimates when already represented in Binance wallet totals.

decisions.rule: Separate fund holdings, cash creations/redemptions, in-kind transfers, index rebalancing and reconstructed observations.
exclusions: Do not infer net cash inflow from holdings delta alone.
Do not fill missing GXRP flows with zero.
Do not treat BITW index rebalancing as pure spot ETF flow.

decisions.rule: Do not average third-party stablecoin supply dashboards. Use canonical issuer/contract identifiers and pinned chain state.
decisions.admission_gate: Require raw public RPC or documented API retrieval plus independent reconciliation before model feature admission.

decisions.rule: Separate native XRP, wrapped/custodied XRP, posted collateral, borrow debt, liquidation thresholds, market utilization and actual spot purchases.
decisions.prohibition: A collateral eligibility flag or wrapped token mint is not a new XRP purchase or net external capital.

decisions.rule: AMM TVL, AMM reserves, order-book depth, executable slippage and centralized exchange depth are separate feature families.
decisions.prohibition: Do not use AMM TVL as total market liquidity.

decisions.rule: Do not label XRPL native lending active until amendments pass validator voting and actual protocol positions are observed.
Separate logical payment events, raw ledger transactions, unique payers, agents, merchants, facilitators, chains, asset denomination and settled USD value.
decisions.prohibition: Do not compare Circle's 98.8% claim with global x402 or XRPL totals without matched denominator, time window, chain coverage and event de-duplication.

decisions.rule: Only verified external cash or asset acquisition flows are counted as new capital; borrowing, wrapping, in-kind transfer, custody migration and valuation changes remain separate.
No directional XRP forecast until point-in-time feature snapshots are raw-source verified, protocol dimensions are fixed, walk-forward evaluation is available and source provenance is checked.

known_limitations: Feature snapshot SHA is recorded as metadata but the ledger does not itself read and verify the snapshot bytes against that hash.
Source registry checks can be NOT_CHECKED when no registry is supplied.
Walk-forward backtesting, calibration and drift evaluation remain separate unfinished components.
prediction_ledger_gap.next_fix: Make production forecast issuance fail closed unless the source registry and feature snapshot bytes/hash are verified.

platform_coordination_design.deliberation_rule: Independent agents submit separate evidence packages; disagreements and minority objections are retained; a red-team reviewer tests counter-hypotheses; no forced unanimity.
platform_coordination_design.handoff_rule: A handoff is verified only when identity/authentication, permission scope, input/output hashes, timestamps, and destination receipt are recorded.
